label: Bible Study
prompt: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was _____.
verse: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
note: Spoken at Zacchaeus' house — the whole mission statement in one line.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be _____.
verse: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
note: 'Whosoever' is the widest word in the Bible — no fine print, no waiting list.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had _____, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
verse: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
note: The prodigal's father saw him 'a great way off' — which means he'd been watching the road.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I will restore to you the years that the _____ hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
verse: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
note: God's promise after the plague: he can pay back years the swarm devoured — restoration with interest.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And that ye _____ to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
verse: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
note: 'Study to be quiet' — the one homework assignment nearly everyone fails.
